# Quartz Digital

> Quartz Digital is a web design and SEO studio in Hoppers Crossing, Melbourne (VIC, Australia). It builds fast, SEO-ready websites and runs local SEO for tradies, clinics and small businesses in Melbourne's west (Tarneit, Werribee, Hoppers Crossing, Point Cook and surrounds) and across Australia.

Contact: Mohid Ishtiaq, 0466 075 295, https://quartzdigital.com.au
